# AvaLimo

AvaLimo is a luxury chauffeur and black car service based in Missouri City,
serving Greater Houston, Texas. Open 24/7 with flat-rate pricing — no surge
pricing, ever — and real-time flight tracking on airport pickups.

## Services

- Airport transfers (IAH & Hobby)
- Corporate chauffeur service
- Weddings
- Hourly chauffeur service
- Galveston cruise transfers
- Special events transportation

## Service area

Houston, Sugar Land, Missouri City, Katy, The Woodlands, Pearland, Cypress,
Spring, Conroe, Galveston, Humble, Pasadena, League City, Friendswood,
Richmond, Rosenberg, Bellaire, and West University Place.

## Fleet

- Mercedes-Benz S-Class — up to 3 passengers
- Cadillac Escalade — up to 6 passengers
- Mercedes-Benz Sprinter — groups of up to 14

## Popular flat rates

- IAH to Downtown Houston: $125 sedan / $165 SUV
- Hobby Airport to Downtown: $105 sedan / $135 SUV

## Contact
